title: An Artifacts tab in the right sidebar: the models DCLab trained, the tables it read, and each project's files
request: Owner: we must have an artifacts section in the right sidebar to have the models created and the data.
spec: dclab-code server/dclab_runs.js (ownedProjects, sessionArtifacts), server/app.js (artifacts, export), web/app.js (renderArtifacts)
plan: read what R&D exposes: a draft's assets, a project's data and evaluation, its four exports
the session's artifacts, read from R&D for the drafts and projects this session owns
a download route for an owned project's files
the tab: model cards (score with its interval, holdout, baseline, approval), data cards (view rows, CSV), file buttons
tests, sync check, a look in the browser

decisions.decision: a model is shown as its evaluation, with the notebook and the code export as its files
decisions.why: R&D keeps no model file; its code export rebuilds the model and recomputes the holdout number

decisions.decision: every model card says whether its owner approved it for production, and marks synthetic data
decisions.why: a benchmark score alone must never read as production-ready (R&D rule 6)

decisions.decision: the files are reachable only for a project the session owns, and only R&D's four exports
decisions.why: the same ownership the Jobs tab uses; no path from the page into other R&D routes

decisions.decision: the four export routes join the sync check
decisions.why: a change in R&D fails the check instead of breaking a download

change: dclab-code: server/dclab_runs.js, server/app.js, server/config.js, web/index.html, web/app.js, web/style.css, tests/server.test.js.

findings.defect: an R&D refusal was shown as a guessed reason
findings.scenario: the data changed after the final stage: /export/code answers 409, the button said 'the project needs its stages first'
findings.cause: every 409 got one fixed message; DclabHttp.raw dropped R&D's detail
findings.fix: raw() keeps R&D's detail; the route passes it on
findings.test: server test: the 409's own words reach the page

findings.defect: the newest drafts and projects could drop off
findings.scenario: a session with 9 drafts, the 9th built: its project missing from the tab, its export 404
findings.cause: slice(0, limit) on sets in insertion order kept the oldest
findings.fix: slice(-limit); the export's ownership check reads up to 200

findings.defect: R&D's exports failed (500) for a project named in Persian
findings.scenario: a Persian project name in Content-Disposition: UnicodeEncodeError latin-1
findings.cause: the name was written raw into a Latin-1 header
findings.fix: R&D: one attachment() helper, ASCII name plus filename*
findings.test: R&D test_studio exports a Persian-named project

measurements.name: real R&D
measurements.gate: the tab shows a finished project and its files download
measurements.result: Linear SVM, ROC-AUC 0.838 (0.781 to 0.882), holdout 400 read once; report 11 KB, solution report 7 KB, notebook 12 KB, code 0.9 MB; another session 404; 50 rows shown

measurements.name: sync-check
measurements.gate: every route used exists in R&D on GitHub
measurements.result: in sync with R&D 50a93906; 18 of 18 agents

outcome: Beside the chat, the person sees what the work produced: each model with its honest score, each table, and the files to take away.
lessons: Show a model with what makes its number honest (interval, holdout read once, the baseline, approval), never the number alone.
risks: only the latest of several drafts' projects beyond eight are shown
